resources.string: Allow notifications, then restart the search for sound and vibration alerts.
Network settings are unavailable on this phone.

1. Connect the devices
Enable mobile data and connect Barka Tunnel. Turn on the phone Wi-Fi hotspot. Connect the PC to this hotspot using its Wi-Fi password. The phone uses mobile data; it does not need to join a Wi-Fi network.

2. Start sharing
Open Settings → VPN sharing to PC. Select the hotspot local address and tap START. It must be reachable from the PC; it normally matches the phone gateway shown in the PC Wi-Fi connection details. Do not select the mobile network or VPN tunnel address.

3. Read the four fields
IP ADDRESS: enter this in the PC proxy address field, without http:// or a port.
PORT: enter this number in the separate Port field.
USERNAME and PASSWORD: proxy credentials requested by the browser. This password is different from the hotspot Wi-Fi password. Use the current values; they may change after restarting sharing.

4. Set up the PC
In Firefox Settings, search for proxy and open Connection Settings. Choose Manual proxy configuration. Enter IP ADDRESS under HTTP Proxy and PORT in Port. Enable using the same proxy for HTTPS. Confirm, open an HTTPS website and enter USERNAME and PASSWORD when prompted.

5. Use or stop
Keep the VPN and hotspot active. Sharing continues after closing this screen. Only proxy-configured applications use the VPN: TCP is supported, UDP is not. Games and applications that ignore the proxy are not covered. Tap STOP or use the notification, then disable the proxy on the PC.

Troubleshooting
Check the phone VPN, PC hotspot connection, address and port. If the hotspot or address changes, stop sharing, reopen this screen and restart with the correct address. Disconnecting the VPN stops sharing.

Start
Connect the VPN, open Settings → Test VPN speed and tap START. Watch the animated phases.

Results
HTTPS latency is in milliseconds; download and upload are in Mbps. Up to about 2.5 MB passes through the VPN. Results depend on signal, servers and other traffic.

Save data
Avoid unnecessary repeat tests. STOP cancels the measurement. A VPN disconnect stops the test without switching to direct Internet.

Purchase or renew
Open BECOME A RESELLER, choose a duration and check the price. Promotions show a countdown. Complete payment and return to retrieve account details.

Your reseller panel
Use the displayed link and credentials. Keep them safe. Access depends on account validity; contact support for frozen or expired accounts.

Generate codes
Choose a subscription or a 2, 3 or 6 hour test. Check the duration before generating. Customers activate separately supplied codes on ACTIVATION CODE; in-app purchases use automatic activation.

Check
Use Settings or the update invitation in the app.

Download
Internal downloads display progress on Home. Return after interruption to resume when supported by the server. Do not clear app data during download.

Install
Follow the Android installation prompt. If required, authorize installations from Barka Tunnel, then return. Android controls this permission.

After installation
Reopen the app, check ABOUT and allow synchronization. If Android refuses an older version, contact support before uninstalling to avoid losing local data.
